# Domia

> Domia is an open-source (Apache-2.0) voice agent that runs entirely on hardware you own. It talks with you, remembers you and acts through the skills you connect. No cloud, no accounts.

A node starts neutral and takes its role from configuration applied in the web console: apply a template or build the configuration from scratch, and save your own setups as templates. The same software runs standalone, as a hub for several rooms, or as a thin device that delegates the heavy stages to a hub. It adapts to your hardware.

## How a conversation works

1. The listening device hears the wake word.
2. Speech is transcribed as you talk, and turn detection decides when you have finished.
3. Routing: a known command matches a template and takes the fast path, where the skill is called directly without the model. Otherwise the local language model receives a shortlist of the skills that fit the request and decides whether to call one or just answer.
4. The reply starts being spoken while the model is still writing.
5. Talk over it and it stops and listens. Follow-up mode keeps the microphone open for the next sentence.

## Skills

Skills connect over MCP. Built-in tools cover time, date, timers, alarms, reminders, volume and routines, and work from the first turn. Home Assistant and Music Assistant are the skill providers tested every day; they, and any other MCP server, start working once connected in the console, and each can be switched off per identity. Every skill has a policy (allow, ask first or block), editable per identity. Locks, alarms, sirens and covers ask first by default.

## Memory and identity

Memory is stored on the node: recent turns, facts, a knowledge base the owner writes, episodes and a user model. A reflection pass when idle updates mood and facts. Each Domia has a name, a voice, a temperament and a mood. One machine can host several identities, and one hub can serve a Domia per room.

## Rooms and mesh

Room microphones and speakers connect as satellites, including the Home Assistant Voice PE with its factory firmware and Wyoming satellites. Nodes discover each other and delegate stages peer to peer with a shared secret. A node must never be exposed to the internet.

## Console

The console manages one or many nodes: Overview, Fleet, Broadcast, Satellites, Templates, Conversations, Chat, Emotions, Memories, Analytics and Settings. A read-only demo is at https://console.domia.ai.
